conflicts.note: When R20 applies it replaces R08 on the card; R08 is shown struck through with the reason.

rules.if_text: Our jungler and nearby laners have Strong Lvl 1 and theirs don't
rules.then: Invade their jungle on that side (steal camps / buff)
rules.why: Strong-dueling jungler + laner support can take 3 quadrants vs a weak duelist
rules.inputs: Champion Tags: Lvl 1 for jungler + top/mid/bot
rules.oe_test: First blood, jungle CS diff at 10
rules.when_plain: our jungler's level-1 strength is Strong and the enemy jungler's level-1 strength is not Strong and our laners with Strong level 1 (count) is above the enemy laners with Strong level 1 (count)
rules.approximation: "Nearby laners" read as: more of our laners have Strong level 1 than theirs. Which side to invade is chosen on the card from the strong laners.
rules.when_text: our.jng.lvl1 == Strong AND their.jng.lvl1 != Strong AND our.laners_lvl1_strong > their.laners_lvl1_strong

rules.if_text: Both teams have heavy level-1 vision and no clear Lvl 1 edge
rules.then: Full clear ('handshake'); plan camp timing around first objective spawn instead
rules.why: With vision everywhere, forcing an invade gives nothing away for free
rules.oe_test: Jungle CS diff at 10 close to 0
rules.when_plain: our level-1 edge (Strong minus Weak champions, vs the enemy) is at least -1 and our level-1 edge (Strong minus Weak champions, vs the enemy) is at most 1
rules.live_check: Both teams place heavy level-1 vision
rules.approximation: "No clear Lvl 1 edge" read as: level-1 edge within one champion either way.

rules.if_text: Our jungler is a weak duelist vs a strong-dueling enemy jungler
rules.then: Start on the opposite side, yield contested camps, path toward lanes with priority
rules.why: Contesting a stronger duelist early loses camps and time
rules.inputs: Champion Tags: Jungle early / Lvl 1 for both junglers
rules.oe_test: Jungle gold diff at 15 in these matchups
rules.when_plain: our jungler's level-1 strength is Weak and the enemy jungler's level-1 strength is Strong

rules.if_text: Always
rules.then: Start the jungle on the side away from where you want to play; finish toward the lanes with Strong laning (priority)
rules.why: Arrive where your laners can move first and win the 2v2 / scuttle
rules.inputs: Champion Tags: Laning per lane + jungler side
rules.oe_test: Gold diff at 10 for the lanes the jungler paths toward
rules.when_plain: always

rules.if_text: We have no lane priority on a side
rules.then: Don't invade or fight there; play the other side
rules.why: Without priority the enemy collapses first
rules.oe_test: First blood / kills at 10 when invading without priority (needs events)
rules.when_plain: our {lane} lane priority is Weak
rules.approximation: A side = its side lane (top side = top lane, bot side = bot lane). "No priority" read as Weak, not Even.

rules.if_text: Enemy jungler is shown on one side (gank, objective, or seen)
rules.then: Trade: invade, gank or take an objective on the opposite side; don't run across late
rules.why: Cross-map plays carry no counter-gank risk and beat a late counter-gank
rules.oe_test: Not testable from OE; VOD/position data

rules.if_text: Early comp (Timing = Early, high early score) with bot/mid priority
rules.then: Contest first Grubs and first Dragon; stack drakes
rules.why: Early comps must convert priority into objectives before they fall off
rules.inputs: Champion Tags: Timing, Early score, Laning (bot/mid)
rules.oe_test: First Grubs / first dragon win rate for early comps vs late comps
rules.when_plain: our comp timing is Early and (our bot lane priority is Strong or our mid lane priority is Strong)
rules.approximation: "High early score" is not checked separately; comp timing Early stands in for it.
rules.when_text: our.timing == Early AND (our.bot.prio == Strong OR our.mid.prio == Strong)

rules.if_text: Late / scaling comp facing an early comp
rules.then: Don't contest early objectives; trade on the opposite side (camps, plates, other objective) and protect the scaling carry
rules.why: Scaling comps lose early 50/50 fights; matching or trading keeps the gap small
rules.inputs: Champion Tags: Timing for both comps
rules.oe_test: Gold diff at 15 for late comps that gave first objective vs contested it
rules.when_plain: our comp timing is Late and the enemy comp timing is Early

rules.if_text: We are stronger at the objective (numbers or spike)
rules.then: Start the objective; if they contest, turn and fight ('power dragon')
rules.why: Win-win: free objective or a favourable fight
rules.oe_test: First dragon fights won by the comp with the earlier spike
rules.when_plain: how much earlier our comp spikes than the enemy's is above 0
rules.live_check: We have more champions at the objective
rules.approximation: Only the spike half is read from the draft; the numbers half is a live check.

rules.if_text: Objective spawning soon
rules.then: Keep farming and arrive just in time; don't stand at the pit early
rules.why: Waiting wastes tempo the enemy can use elsewhere
rules.oe_test: Not testable from OE (needs timelines)

rules.if_text: Our jungler is a facilitator (tank/engage) vs a carry jungler
rules.then: Plan early ganks and plays rather than a farming race
rules.why: A facilitator loses the farm race; plays offset the expected gold-at-15 deficit
rules.inputs: Champion Tags: Primary style, Engage for both junglers
rules.oe_test: Jungle gold diff at 15 for facilitator-vs-carry matchups
rules.when_plain: our jungler is a facilitator (tank / engage) and the enemy jungler is a carry jungler

rules.if_text: One of our lanes is winning
rules.then: Don't gank it; ward its river so it can push freely. Gank lanes where the enemy jungler is confirmed far away
rules.why: A winning lane only needs vision; ganks are better spent elsewhere
rules.oe_test: Not testable from OE (needs events)

rules.if_text: Our draft has no Strong laning in any lane and at least one Weak lane
rules.then: Flag in draft: early game will be passive; plan safe vision and trade objectives
rules.why: With no priority anywhere, the enemy snowballs and you can't answer
rules.oe_test: Gold diff at 15 and win rate for drafts with 0 Strong lanes and 1+ Weak lane
rules.when_plain: our lanes with Strong priority (count) is 0 and our lanes with Weak priority (count) is at least 1

rules.if_text: Lane priority bot/mid after levels 2-3
rules.then: Support and jungler ward the enemy jungle on that side; mid roams to the jungler's side
rules.why: Priority turns into vision and camp denial
rules.inputs: Champion Tags: Laning (bot, mid), Roam / gank
rules.oe_test: Wards placed / vision score at 15 (if available)
rules.when_plain: our bot lane priority is Strong or our mid lane priority is Strong
rules.approximation: "After levels 2-3" is not checked; the draft's expected priority stands in for it.

rules.if_text: Choosing between first Dragon and first Grubs
rules.then: Default to first Dragon unless the comp or lane priority clearly favours top side
rules.why: Pro players cite roughly a 5% higher win rate for first Dragon than first Grubs (their claim, unverified)
rules.inputs: Lane priority bot vs top; comp timing
rules.oe_test: Win rate after first dragon vs after first Grubs, controlled for team strength. Testable directly in OE
rules.when_plain: always
rules.unless_plain: our top lane priority is Strong and our bot lane priority is not Strong
rules.approximation: "Comp clearly favours top side" read as: top priority Strong while bot is not.

rules.if_text: One of our lanes is Weak and likely to be ganked early
rules.then: Jungler starts on that side to cover it, then paths out
rules.why: A losing lane that gets ganked early can be unplayable for the rest of laning. Exception to R08
rules.oe_test: Gold diff at 10 for the weak lane when the jungler started on its side (needs start-side data)
rules.when_plain: our {lane} lane priority is Weak
rules.approximation: "Likely to be ganked early" is not checked separately; every Weak lane counts.

rules.if_text: Planning a gank or dive
rules.then: Hide the intent: don't walk toward the tower or clear wards in view right before committing
rules.why: Showing intent gives the enemy jungler time to arrive
rules.oe_test: Not testable from OE

rules.if_text: Enemy starts Dragon while we have a Teleport advantage top
rules.then: Give the Dragon; dive top or take plates instead
rules.why: Trading the objective for a dive and plates can be worth more than contesting
rules.inputs: Summoner spell state (live), Champion Tags: Engage
rules.oe_test: Not testable from OE (needs timelines)

rules.if_text: Lane opponent is missing a key early item (boots) or we hit level 6 first
rules.then: Trade hard or threaten the all-in to force them off the wave
rules.why: Item and level-6 windows are the cleanest moments to win lane
rules.oe_test: Not testable from OE (needs timelines)

rules.if_text: We'd be drafting a losing top matchup by default
rules.then: Prefer an even or winning matchup unless the comp needs that pick
rules.why: Losing lanes repeatedly drag the early game down
rules.inputs: Champion Tags: Laning for both top laners
rules.oe_test: Top gold diff at 15 by matchup strength
rules.when_plain: our top lane priority is Weak
rules.approximation: On the post-draft card this reads as: our top matchup is expected to lose.

rules.if_text: Early-strong comp with mid and bot priority
rules.then: Push mid and bot together to convert pressure into plates; base on time rather than greed plates
rules.why: Pressure only counts if it turns into gold; greed gives it back
rules.oe_test: Tower plates and gold diff at 15 for early comps
rules.when_plain: our comp timing is Early and our mid lane priority is Strong and our bot lane priority is Strong
rules.when_text: our.timing == Early AND our.mid.prio == Strong AND our.bot.prio == Strong

rules.if_text: Lane priority on both bot and top sides (or the enemy jungler is shown elsewhere)
rules.then: Take both first scuttles
rules.why: Double scuttle is a clear early jungle win (gold, XP, vision)
rules.oe_test: Not in OE directly; proxy: jungle CS/XP diff at 10
rules.when_plain: our bot lane priority is Strong and our top lane priority is Strong
rules.live_check: Enemy jungler shown on the other side
rules.approximation: The "or enemy jungler shown elsewhere" half is a live check.

rules.if_text: We're ahead after the early game
rules.then: Protect the lead: don't chase without vision or key summoners; regroup on objectives
rules.why: Leads are often thrown in a few bad fights right after laning
rules.oe_test: Win rate given gold lead at 15 by league (comeback rate)

rules.if_text: The enemy jungler has a predictable start (same first camps, smites a buff at a set time)
rules.then: Plan a timed invade or buff steal around his habit
rules.why: Level-1/2 habits are scoutable from recent games and punishable
rules.oe_test: Not in OE; needs VOD/timelines

rules.if_text: A champion has hard-losing lane matchups and the enemy still holds counterpick
rules.then: Don't blind it; blind a flex or matchup-safe pick and save the greedy pick for counterpick
rules.why: Blinding matchup-dependent picks hands the enemy free counters
rules.oe_test: Lane gold diff at 15 for blind vs counter picks (OE has pick order)
rules.when_plain: our {lane} laner was picked before its lane opponent (blind) and our {lane} laner's champion has hard-losing matchups
rules.approximation: On the post-draft card this reads as: we blinded a matchup-dependent pick.

rules.if_text: Enemy mid-jungle duo is stronger in early 2v2s than ours
rules.then: Avoid a weak-2v2 jungler; don't contest river fights with mid before your spikes
rules.why: The early map is decided by the mid-jungle 2v2
rules.inputs: Champion Tags: Lvl 1, Laning, Early spike for both mid-jungle duos
rules.oe_test: Jungle + mid gold diff at 15 by duo strength
rules.when_plain: our mid-jungle 2v2 strength is Weak

rules.if_text: Building the bot lane
rules.then: Pair a roaming or weak-laning support with a self-sufficient ADC; pair a lane-dependent ADC with a lane-winning support; into dive/engage, pick an anti-dive bot lane
rules.why: A support that can't win lane leaves a lane-dependent ADC with nothing
rules.inputs: Champion Tags: Laning, Roam / gank, Engage, Peel
rules.oe_test: Bot gold diff at 15 by support-ADC pairing
rules.when_plain: ((our support has 'Roam / gank' or our support's laning tag is Weak) and our ADC's laning tag is not Strong) or (the enemy team's dive threats (count) is at least 2 and our bot lane's peel (count) is 0)
rules.approximation: Only the two warning cases are checked: a roaming or weak-laning support with an ADC that is not Strong in lane, or 2+ enemy dive threats with no bot-lane peel.
rules.when_text: ((our.sup.roam OR our.sup.laning == Weak) AND our.bot.laning != Strong) OR (their.dive_threats >= 2 AND our.botlane_peel == 0)

rules.if_text: We picked a lane-dominant bot duo (poke / level-2 spike)
rules.then: Play to win levels 1-3 and 6 hard; if not ahead by first base, switch to a safe plan
rules.why: Lane-dominant duos are feast or famine and fall off if they don't snowball
rules.oe_test: Bot gold diff at 10 vs game result for lane-dominant duos
rules.when_plain: our ADC's laning tag is Strong and our support's laning tag is Strong

rules.if_text: Enemy bot has an enchanter (Lulu, Janna type)
rules.then: Force the all-in before their support reaches level 6
rules.why: Enchanter ultimates make all-ins much harder after 6
rules.inputs: Champion Tags: Primary style = Protect the carry (support)
rules.oe_test: Not in OE (needs timelines)
rules.when_plain: the enemy support's primary style is Protect the carry
rules.approximation: Enchanter read as: support's primary style is Protect the carry.

rules.if_text: One lane is clearly winning and another can hold on its own
rules.then: Play through the winning lane and let the safe lane soak pressure, instead of rescuing it
rules.why: Accelerating your carry wins more than evening out a lane that's fine anyway
rules.inputs: Live lane state; Champion Tags: Wave clear
rules.oe_test: Not in OE (needs events)

rules.if_text: A lane is about to reset on a natural timer
rules.then: Jungler syncs his base with that lane so they return together
rules.why: Synced resets create 2-man pressure; out-of-sync bases waste tempo
rules.oe_test: Not in OE (needs timelines)

rules.if_text: First scuttle / first objective about to be contested
rules.then: Arrive with the upgraded Smite and plan camps so it's ready on time
rules.why: The smite edge decides early 50/50s
rules.oe_test: Not in OE (needs timelines)

rules.if_text: Mid considering leaving lane to dive bot
rules.then: Only go if the dive is near-certain and the enemy mid can't punish the free lane
rules.why: A free mid lead can cost more than the bot dive gains
rules.inputs: Champion Tags: Roam / gank, Laning (both mids)
rules.oe_test: Mid gold diff at 15 in games with early bot dives (needs events)

rules.if_text: Trading early drakes for cross-map plays
rules.then: Track the enemy's dragon count; stop trading and contest before they reach soul point
rules.why: Trading works until the enemy stacks soul and the game flips
rules.oe_test: Win rate for teams that gave the first 2-3 drakes but led gold at 15 (OE)

rules.if_text: Preparing for a specific opponent
rules.then: Profile each player: gold/XP diff at 15, champion-pool size, win rate on most-played champs, strong-side vs weak-side role. Ban or pressure the predictable or weak-side player
rules.why: Predictable players and weak-side roles are the easiest early targets
rules.oe_test: All computable in OE

rules.if_text: The enemy has a star laner
rules.then: Draft an aggressive counter-lane into him and commit jungle pressure there early
rules.why: A countered star laner without jungle help can't carry; the counter needs the jungler to stick
rules.oe_test: Star laner gold diff at 15 when countered vs not
rules.when_plain: the enemy {lane} laner is a star laner
